description:
Looking for an UI expert to make a working prototype more exciting and fun. Also anyone who likes to dive deeper into the sphereX data and api capabilities is welcome. Are you interested in Astrophysics and have a knack for AI or data analytics? Join the team. Let's look for more events in the data and how to create a stellar screen design visualizing our changing universe.
I have created a web application that navigates the data and visualizes some events.
